slides.sub: Family wealth and earned gains are not the same.

slides.body: In Jyotish, the 2nd house signifies family resources, savings, speech and values. It reflects what you inherit, hold and keep.
The 11th signifies earned gains, networks and fulfilled desires. It reflects what you build and bring in through effort and people.
A strong 2nd house can mean a stable family base. A strong 11th points to income streams you grow yourself. One does not imply the other.
No yoga guarantees wealth. Charts show tendencies, not outcomes. Planning, skills and choices matter far more than any placement.
Free Money Houses Snapshot: your 2nd and 11th house at a glance.
